meta.title: Solutions
meta.description: The same tool, shaped around your industry — hospitality, retail, offices, healthcare, hotels and gyms.

hero.title: Built for every kind of space.
hero.subtitle: Whatever you do, EdgeRize adapts to you. Pick your industry and see how it looks in practice.

hospitality.name: Hospitality
hospitality.tagline: Menus that change on the fly.
hospitality.title: Digital menus and offers for restaurants and cafés.
hospitality.subtitle: Replace printed menus with screens you update in seconds — prices, daily specials and seasonal promotions, always current.

scenarios.title: Digital menu
scenarios.body: Dishes, prices and the daily special with no reprinting or sticker patching.

scenarios.title: Promotions
scenarios.body: Happy hour, seasonal deals and the chef's picks — scheduled in advance.

scenarios.title: Brand & atmosphere
scenarios.body: Visuals and music for your space's identity, at every moment.

retail.name: Retail
retail.title: Prices, promotions and brand on every screen.
retail.subtitle: Grab attention at the entrance and on the shelf — highlight deals, new arrivals and campaigns, and change them instantly across all stores.

scenarios.title: Promotions & sales
scenarios.body: Highlight offers right where the buying decision happens.

scenarios.title: New arrivals
scenarios.body: Introduce a new collection the moment it lands, no waiting on print.

scenarios.title: Brand & campaigns
scenarios.body: Show one consistent message across every store at once.

office.name: Offices
office.title: Announcements, calendars and data for a modern workplace.
office.subtitle: Keep the team informed and make a great impression on visitors — notices, room bookings and key numbers in plain sight.

scenarios.title: Announcements
scenarios.body: Internal news and important messages no one misses.

scenarios.title: Rooms & calendars
scenarios.body: Room availability and the meeting schedule in real time.

scenarios.title: KPIs & dashboards
scenarios.body: Key numbers and team goals on the big screen.

healthcare.name: Healthcare
healthcare.title: Queues, notices and information for patients.
healthcare.subtitle: Ease the load at reception and make waiting more pleasant — clear information, a call-up queue and helpful tips.

scenarios.title: Queues & call-up
scenarios.body: Who's next and at which desk, clearly and without asking.

scenarios.title: Health tips
scenarios.body: Useful information and prevention while patients wait.

scenarios.title: Hours & directions
scenarios.body: Offices, opening hours and directions in one place.

hotels.name: Hotels
hotels.title: Information and experience for your guests.
hotels.subtitle: From the lobby to the lift — greet guests, guide them and showcase the hotel's amenities on elegant screens.

scenarios.title: Welcome & wayfinding
scenarios.body: Greet guests, show a map and point the way to amenities.

scenarios.title: Events & amenities
scenarios.body: The programme, restaurant, spa and offers — clear and beautiful.

scenarios.title: Weather & local guide
scenarios.body: Forecast and nearby recommendations for a better stay.

gyms.name: Gyms
gyms.title: Schedules, motivation and announcements for fitness.
gyms.subtitle: Keep members in the loop and motivated — class schedules, tips and offers on screens throughout the space.

scenarios.title: Class schedule
scenarios.body: Times and trainers, always current and visible to everyone.

scenarios.title: Motivation & tips
scenarios.body: Messages, challenges and tips that lift the energy.

scenarios.title: Memberships & offers
scenarios.body: Deals and new packages right where members see them.

benefits: A modern look for the space
